svg.title: The tree of 65 breast tumor samples
svg.desc: Schematic of Perou et al., Nature 406:747 (2000), Fig. 3a. A dendrogram of 65 tumor samples, traced from the paper's figure. Its branches are colored by group: 8 basal-like samples in orange, 7 ERBB2+ in pink, 11 normal breast-like in light green and 36 luminal, estrogen receptor-positive samples in dark blue; three samples are in no group. Small brackets under the leaves join the two samples taken from the same tumor before and after chemotherapy: 17 of the 20 pairs sit side by side and three pairs, drawn in orange-brown, are apart. Sample names are omitted.
svg.text: the same tumor before and after chemotherapy, side by side (17 pairs)
